meaning: Sets the baseline cerebral venous resistance (Rv_v = 811.3 CGS) in the shared brain parameter dictionary. It is the default drainage resistance every brain model inherits before any per-model or per-patient override.

could_move.what: Baseline venous pressure/flow and CSF pressure in Model 1 solves, since Params.jl reads this default
Model 3 runs including the bistability studies, which depend on the drainage path
Jugular compression comparisons against patient data, where venous resistance is the quantity being perturbed
h-sweep figures in the CIS report if the default is not overridden in the deck
Fitted parameter sets in fits/m3 that may have been fitted relative to this starting value
Documented parameter tables that quote the value

expectation: Unknown in size. Directionally, raising Rv_v raises venous and intracranial pressure at fixed inflow; lowering it does the opposite. Whether downstream models actually see it depends on per-model overrides, which I cannot confirm from this context.

check.why: Single-case verification of a Model 1 fit is much cheaper than a re-fit and shows whether the baseline venous resistance change shifts the fitted solution.
